C0823.title: FBI Warns of Account Takeover Fraud Targeting Financial Institutions
C0823.summary: The FBI issued a warning that cybercriminals are impersonating financial institution staff or creating fake websites to trick victims into revealing login credentials, thereby gaining unauthorized access to online banking, payroll, or health savings accounts. Since January 2025, the IC3 has received over 5,100 related complaints with total losses exceeding $262 million.
